maria: quick heads-up: quant3 onboarding for zephyr-70k shows key miss rate spike at ~11.5k tokens on long prompts (>40k).
eli: minimal repro?
maria: `python -m tests.repro_longctx --model zephyr-70k --quant quant3 --ctx 65536 --seed 11`
maria: behavior: FP32 baseline stays stable; quant3 matches until ~11.5k then tiny rotary scale diff, then kvcache misses.
cheng: any index wrap logs?
maria: yes: `KV_IDX shard=1 idx=1048575 -> 1048576` then immediate `idx=0`. looks like ring index overflow.
natalie: could be packing alignment for int3-style layout shifting memcpy sizes. I'll run with ASAN reduced ctx to step.
sam: schedule CI run for fp32 vs quant3 at 32k/48k/65k and upload kv dumps, please cc @ci-bot.
ci-bot: job queued: rhyme/nightly/zephyr-quant-compare at 2026-03-25T03:00Z; artifacts s3://rhyme-artifacts/zephyr/1845679999/
eli: mitigation idea: tolerant key equality - normalize small scale differences on load behind rollout flag. cheap to try.
maria: prototyping patch: `if quant in ("int3","quant3"): key = key / max(1e-6, l2norm(key)) * cached_scale`
cheng: add unit that fuzzes tiny scale deltas and asserts hit-rate stability.
natalie: running ASAN now, will report back with traces.
ci-bot: PR opened: github.com/redwood-inference/serving/pull/5824 by maria - tests queued.
sam: thanks, keep us posted. :thumbsup:
